title: Mi Band (5): Enhancements
symptom: User requests enhancements for Mi Band 5 watchface: color of HIGH/LOW values should match xDrip+ (orange/red), display age of last blood sugar, disable syncing, show steps/heart rate, bold text for alerts, and fix date format missing dot.
fix: For heart rate: enable 'Use Health Data' and 'Heart Rate sensor' in Settings -> Smartwatch Features -> Smart watch sensors, and configure heart rate update interval in MiFit or third-party app. For outdated data: if no new values for 15 min, BG data is crossed out; also a Bluetooth connection status icon styled as crossed line appears above the bg value when connection lost.
evidence_quote: To see heart rate data in xdrip, the options "Use Health Data" and "Heart Rate sensor" which is located in Settings -> Smartwarch Features -> Smart watch sensors,  should be enabled.
